meaning: Your pay or benefits go straight into your bank account by computer. No paper check is needed.
clues: It puts money into your bank account.
Nobody hands you anything, and there is no paper to carry.
Employers use it for paychecks, and some government benefits arrive this way too.
The money often shows up on payday, with no trip to the bank.
It has two words. The first has six letters and starts with D.
assumes: Mobile check deposit uses a photo of a paper check
A prepaid card holds money loaded ahead of time

decoys.meaning: Using your phone's camera to photograph a paper check. The money goes into your bank account without a trip to the bank.
A card you load with money ahead of time. You can spend only what you loaded.
A plastic card linked to your bank account. When you pay with it, the money comes straight out of your account.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, payday meant a paper envelope and a trip to the bank. Great exercise.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Now the money arrives on its own. Ask your employer or benefit office to set it up, and give bank details only to people you trust.
